															Primary School Teacher (Post Code 1 to 4)
															
															
															 

															10150
															
															
															1. Mandatory Eligibility:
															The candidate must have passed the Primary Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by MP Employees Selection Board, Bhopal for the year 2020 or 2024, with a qualifying score as prescribed.

															2. Educational Qualifications (as per Rule 8, Schedule-III of Bharti Niyam 2018):
															Candidate must fulfill any one of the following qualifications:

															(i) Higher Secondary (12th) or its equivalent with minimum 50% marks
															AND
															2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) or equivalent / Special Education Diploma

															OR

															(ii) Higher Secondary (12th) or equivalent with minimum 45% marks
															AND
															2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.)
															(as per NCTE Regulation 2002)

															OR

															(iii) Higher Secondary (12th) or equivalent with minimum 50% marks
															AND
															4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)

															OR

															(iv) Graduation
															AND
															2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) or equivalent

															Note:
															Reserved Categories (SC/ST, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, and Divyangjan) will receive 5% relaxation in minimum qualifying marks.

															3. Validity of Certificates:
															Academic/Professional qualifications must be obtained from a recognized institution only.

															Any additional essential documents issued by competent authorities will be considered valid only after proper verification and submission within the due date.
															
														
														
															
															 

															Primary School Teacher -Science (Post Code 5 to 10)
															
															
															 

															2939
															
															
															Candidate must have Minimum 50% marks in Higher Secondary (12th) with Science stream or equivalent
															AND

															2-year Diploma in Elementary Education / Special Education
															OR

															4-year Bachelor’s Degree in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) with relevant subject.

															Note:
															Candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) will be granted relaxation of up to 5% in the minimum qualifying marks.

															Validity of Degrees / Diplomas
															Only degrees/diplomas from recognized institutions (academic and professional) will be considered valid.

															Additionally, all required certificates issued by competent authorities recognized by the State Government will be accepted only after verification and submission by the candidate within the stipulated time.

																Pay Scale: Primary School Teacher: Rs.25300 + Dearness Allowance 
																
																
																Selection Process:  Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.
